A second withdrawal of the same amount must occur within 7 days of the first, but only if the withdrawal also met the criteria of the balance exceeding $30,000.   Additionally, a third withdrawal should take place at least 7 days after the second, ensuring that a minimum balance of $10,000 remains in the account.   Furthermore, a fourth withdrawal of $20,000 is to occur after the balance again surpasses $30,000.   Initial withdrawal of $20,000 when the balance reaches over $30,000 and second withdrawal will be done again within 7 days of previous withdrawal with similar criteria.
 Third withdrawal has to be done after 7 days of 2nd withdrawal (given that first withdrawal was done within 7 days of second withdrawal)
 Starting 3rd withdrawal - minimum balance to remain in the bank is $10,000 and rest can be withdrawn.   4th withdrawal to be made after the balance reaches over $30,000 and the withdrawal amount will be $20,000.My current formula is:
   IF((M7+O7)>$P$6,$P$1,0)", "spreadsheet_path": "spreadsheet/55039", "instruction_type": "Cell-Level Manipulation", "answer_position": "Q7:Q153"}, "rollout": {"task_id": "55039", "output": "import openpyxl
import os

input_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/55039/1_55039_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/55039_0_012da6d9/1_55039_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(input_path)
ws = wb["TEST"] if "TEST" in wb.sheetnames else wb[wb.sheetnames[0]]

# The answer range is exactly Q7:Q153.
# Formula logic:
#   1st withdrawal in each cycle: when pre-withdrawal balance P exceeds threshold P6, withdraw P6-10000 (20,000 when P6=30,000).
#   2nd withdrawal: same amount, only if P exceeds threshold and it is within 7 days of the previous withdrawal.
#   3rd withdrawal: at least 7 days after the previous withdrawal; withdraw all balance above 10,000.
#   4th withdrawal: same fixed amount again once P exceeds threshold.
# Then the pattern repeats for subsequent withdrawals.
for r in range(7, 154):
    prev_q_range = f"$Q$6:Q{r-1}"
    prev_f_range = f"$F$6:F{r-1}"
    cnt = f'COUNTIF({prev_q_range},">0")'
    phase = f"MOD({cnt},4)"
    last_withdraw_date = f"LOOKUP(2,1/(N({prev_q_range})>0),{prev_f_range})"
    fixed_withdrawal = "($P$6-10000)"
    
    formula = (
        f'=IF({phase}=0,'
            f'IF(P{r}>$P$6,{fixed_withdrawal},0),'
            f'IF({phase}=1,'
                f'IF(AND(P{r}>$P$6,F{r}-{last_withdraw_date}<=7),{fixed_withdrawal},0),'
                f'IF({phase}=2,'
                    f'IF(F{r}-{last_withdraw_date}>=7,MAX(P{r}-10000,0),0),'
                    f'IF(P{r}>$P$6,{fixed_withdrawal},0)'
                f')'
            f')'
        f')'
    )
    ws[f"Q{r}"] = formula

# Ensure Excel recalculates formulas when opened.
try:
    wb.calculation.fullCalcOnLoad = True
    wb.calculation.forceFullCalc = True
    wb.calculation.calcMode = "auto"
except Exception:
    pass

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)

# Basic verification printout.
check_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(output_path, data_only=False)
check_ws = check_wb["TEST"] if "TEST" in check_wb.sheetnames else check_wb[check_wb.sheetnames[0]]
print("Saved:", output_path)
print("Q7:", check_ws["Q7"].value)
print("Q8:", check_ws["Q8"].value)
print("Q153:", check_ws["Q153"].value)
